messages:
incident-bot: PAGE: billing-shadow-heartbeat anomaly detected for prod-emit-service. severity: high. Symptoms: delayed usage ingestion (~12-20m lag), token counting gaps, and automated overage flags firing for some customers. Auto-triage created.

oncall-kate: taking this. thanks for the page. starting quick triage — pinging SRE and billing.

sre-jamie: on it. first guess is a late consumer ack / Kafka lag causing windows to misalign. can someone post recent consumer-lag and emitter-heartbeat logs?

ops-bot: metrics: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/emit/heartbeat?panelId=3 (spike at 2026-03-17T11:12Z), consumer lag jump ~15k msgs.

billing-ellen: SQL check on processed_windows:```
SELECT window_start, count(*) FROM usage_events
WHERE processed_at BETWEEN now() - interval '1 hour' AND now()
GROUP BY window_start ORDER BY window_start DESC LIMIT 10;
```
returns gaps around 2026-03-17T11:10-11:18 (zero/low counts). correlates with graph.

sre-jamie: thanks. can we confirm emitter pod restarts or proxy retries around that time? run: `kubectl get pods -n prod-emit -o wide` and `kubectl logs prod-emit-0 --since=30m`

dev-ryan: ran logs, saw repeated 503 from internal-proxy and a backlog flush:```
[11:11:58Z] WARN proxy: upstream 503 retry
[11:12:02Z] INFO emitter: flush queued 18234 msgs
[11:12:12Z] INFO emitter: window commit failed, retrying
```
looks like a short proxy outage then burst replay.

support-lina: top-affected customers from alert pack: org_882, org_17, org_az3 — they got automatic overage flags in last hour and support tickets starting to appear.

product-rahul: what's the customer impact window? do they see permanent charges or temporary flags?

billing-ellen: overage flags are automated on shadow counts; billing calc job hasn't finalized yet. likely false positives if we backfill correctly. recommend suppressing immediate alerts and holding invoices for affected windows until reconciliation.

oncall-kate: agree. @billing-ellen can you temporarily mute overage-alerts rule for ~2h? we can lift after backfill + reconciliation.

billing-ellen: muting rule `overage-detect-shadow` now — CLI: `redwood-billing rules mute --id overage-detect-shadow --expires 2h` — done. confirmation id: mute_20260317_1125. :white_check_mark:

sre-jamie: mitigation path: 1) enable fallback aggregator to accept replayed messages without creating duplicate windows; 2) kick off backfill job to ingest delayed messages; 3) run reconciliation to recalc charges for windows in 11:05-11:25. I'll run 1) and 2) now.

dev-ryan: enabling fallback aggregator: `kubectl patch deploy prod-emit -n prod --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"fallback-agg":"enabled"}}}}}'` -> rolled to 2/2 pods. starting backfill job: `jobs/backfill-1728681234` started. job id: backfill-2761. progress: 0%

ops-bot: backfill job started, tailing logs...

dev-ryan: backfill progress update: 40% processed, throughput ~120k events/min, applying dedupe filter for window keys to avoid double-counting.

sre-jamie: good. I'm seeing the proxy cluster (proxy-b) had a brief GC stall at 11:11 which caused upstream 503s. suspect transient resource pressure + rate spike. action: raise proxy-b replica target and add CPU burst. I'll open an infra PR after triage.

support-lina: FYI support has messaged org_882 with a note: "We're aware of a transient billing alert, investigating; no final charges applied yet." template sent.

product-rahul: recommend proactive status page note: short incident, potential overage flags visible but suppression enabled. I'll draft a short blurb.

billing-ellen: reconciliation run queued. ETA ~25 minutes once backfill completes. holding any invoice finalization for affected windows.

oncall-kate: handoff: I'll stay on for another 20m; if still in progress @sre-jamie can take overnight watch. Primary owner for follow-ups: jamie (SRE), billing-ellen (billing), dev-ryan (backfill).

sre-jamie: accepted. I'll monitor backfill and run reconciliation. preliminary root cause: proxy-b GC pause + consumer replay causing windowing misalignment and shadow emitter to emit late windows triggering overage detector. action items: (a) scale proxy-b and adjust GC flags (infra PR), (b) add rate-limit smoothing on emitter replays, (c) add additional heartbeat alert early-warning threshold.

dev-ryan: backfill job completed: job backfill-2761 exit status=0, applied dedupe, affected windows reconciled: 11:05-11:25.

billing-ellen: reconciliation complete. corrected counts pushed, suppressed alerts unmuted: `redwood-billing rules unmute --id mute_20260317_1125` -> done. Verified invoices not finalized for these windows.

support-lina: support: closing related tickets with customer note and offer to review any suspicious charges.

oncall-kate: thanks team. Incident resolved for now. putting a short postmortem + timeline on #postmortems and scheduling a 30-min follow-up tomorrow to review infra PR and alert tuning.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: billing-shadow-heartbeat anomaly -> resolved at 2026-03-17T11:36Z. severity: med->resolved. Follow-up tags: postmortem-required, billing-impact, proxy-gc."
